question: In September 2024, the Supreme Court has affirmed that the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act,__ applies to all women in India regardless of their religion or social background.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005** is a landmark legislation enacted in India to address issues of domestic violence against women.
 
• The Act was **passed in Parliament in August 2005** and came into effect on **October 26, 2006**. It aims to provide protection to women who are victims of domestic violence.
 
• This legislation applies to **all women in India, irrespective of their religion, caste, or social background**. It is a secular law and ensures equal protection for women across all communities.
 
• The Act defines **domestic violence** broadly, including physical, emotional, sexual, verbal, and economic abuse. It recognizes the rights of women to live in a violence-free environment within their homes.
